messages:
Priya S: Hey — I'm starting the infra team's Notion onboarding page. Should I create it in the Infra team space or in Company Docs? Also who do I ping for edit access and a starter template? Thanks.

devex-bot: Hi Priya — templates live in Company Docs > Templates > Onboarding. You can request a template or perms two ways: fill the template request form at https://redwood.internal/notion-templates or run `/request-template` in #devex. Quick path: Company Docs » Templates » Onboarding » Infra Starter :robot_face:

Michael T: Priya — create it under the Infra team space (so it's discoverable by infra on the sidebar). Use the "Infra Onboarding Starter" template. If you need edit perms ping @devex or drop me the page URL and I can add you.

Nina L: I just added you as a Page Editor on the Infra team space. Try opening https://notion.so/redwood/infra-team-space and see if you can edit. If not, tell me which email you used and I'll re-check. :raised_hands:

Onboarding Squad: Template checklist (short):
1) Quickstart (1-2 commands + env var notes)
2) Who-to-ask (names + aliases)
3) Access matrix (repos, infra, Notion perms)
4) Runbook & important links
5) First-week suggested tasks

Copy flow: ```Open Templates -> Infra Onboarding Starter -> ••• -> Duplicate -> Move to Infra team space -> Rename``` Replace placeholders: {{oncall}}, {{repo}}, {{pager}}.

Priya S: Got it — thanks Nina and @Onboarding Squad. I can edit now. Will duplicate the template and start populating quickstart + who-to-ask. Will ping if anything's missing. :heart:
thread_description: new hire onboarding / Notion templates and edit access
